name: Balkrishna Industries Ltd (BKT)
_note: Fact base as of 30-Sep-2026. Consolidated figures (Screener basis) unless marked standalone. BKT reports one segment (tyres incl. carbon black). Sources: AR FY26 (filed 6-Jul-2026), Q4FY26 call (9-May-2026, transcript filed 14-May-2026) and presentation, Q1FY27 call (30-Jul-2026, transcript filed 5-Aug-2026) and presentation (Jul-2026).

profile.founded: Off-highway tyres since 1987 (first plant at Aurangabad/Waluj); founder M P Poddar
profile.plants: Tyre plants at Waluj (Maharashtra), Bhiwadi and Chopanki (Rajasthan) and Bhuj (Gujarat); carbon-black plant, mould plant, drum plant and a wind farm

fy26.fxSwingNote: Realised FX on sales moved from +202 to -164 cr and unrealised FX from +7 to -144 cr (standalone): a -517 cr swing, larger than the -406 cr fall in standalone PAT. The rupee weakened against hedges booked at lower rates.
fy26.dpsNote: Rs4 a quarter: three interims of Rs4 plus a final of Rs4 (Q4FY26 call)

mix.src: AR FY26 p.25; Q4FY26 presentation p.10

fy26.exportsSrc: ICICI Direct company update (31-Jul-2026): exports ~64% of FY26 revenue

otherIncomeFY26.screenerNote: Screener books investment gains and PPE profit (FY26 Rs171 cr, FY25 Rs180 cr) as 'exceptional items' inside other income; they recur with the treasury book and are not one-offs in the PLAYBOOK §4 sense. FY26 foreign-exchange losses sit in other expenses (EBITDA); FY25's Rs267 cr FX gain sat in other income.

treasuryMar26.src: AR FY26 consolidated notes 5, 10, 12, 13, 19, 24; Screener balance sheet; Q4FY26 call (standalone net debt Rs895 cr)

hedges.src: AR FY26 standalone note on hedge accounting (EUR 259 mn FY27 at 1 EUR = INR 107.16) and consolidated note 39; Q4FY26 and Q1FY27 calls; Q1FY26 call (28-Jul-2025: Rs93.6 hedge rate vs ~Rs97 spot average), Q2FY26 call (Nov-2025), Q3FY26 call (Feb-2026: ~Rs97)

mix.note: Decoded from the Q1FY27 deck's volume chart (p.7); the call confirms India ~40% of volume and India above Europe for the first time

callPoints: Highest-ever quarterly OHT volume: 93,770 MT (+16%); Europe stable on a weak base, India strong across agriculture, construction and mining, Americas better with the US tariff 'settling at 10% levels'.
~5% price increase taken during Q1, fully in the price from Q2; raw-material basket +5% more in Q2-Q3, ~3% of sales, ~2pp margin hit in the coming quarter (M.S. Bajaj).
EUR realisation ~Rs102 in Q1 (Rs99 in Q4FY26); FY27 hedge rate 'better' (not disclosed); spot ~Rs110.
Freight ~5% of revenue; could rise if the Middle East disruption continues.
Carbon black phase 2 commissioned: capacity 360,000 MTPA (capex Rs800 cr); captive power 64 MW (Rs125 cr); ~10% of revenue from third-party carbon black.

On-highway: TBR supplies started in April; 2-wheeler tyres seeded; PCR pilot due Q3FY27; 'FY27 a year of building the portfolio, FY28 onwards serious business'; Rs5,000 cr on-highway revenue target for 2030 reaffirmed.
Capex ~Rs1,000 cr in Q1 and Rs1,500-2,000 cr more in FY27; Rs3,000 cr left of the Rs6,800 cr plan; maintenance ~Rs200 cr a year on top.
Applied for US reciprocal-tariff refunds (BKT is importer of record); amount and timing not disclosed.
Employee cost +18% (Gujarat minimum-wage increase, increments, staff for new businesses); new CFO Saroj Khuntia (ex-CG Power).

vision2030.src: Q1FY27 presentation pp.11-20; Q4FY26 call; ICICI Direct (31-Jul-2026) for the current 5-6% global share

capexPlan.fy27GuideJul: 2,500-3,000 in total (Rs1,000 cr in Q1 plus Rs1,500-2,000 cr)
projects: Carbon black phase 2 (to 360,000 MTPA, Rs800 cr, done Q1FY27)
Captive power 40 to 64 MW (Rs125 cr, Feb-2026)
CV radial (TBR) phase 1 (Rs750 cr, 800 tyres/day fungible CVR/OHT, Feb-2026); phase 2 under way
Additional Rs2,000 cr approved May-2026: OHT and on-highway capacity, AI automation, sustainability
capexPlan.src: Q4FY26 call (9-May-2026); Q1FY27 call (30-Jul-2026); AR FY26 (FY26 capex Rs2,984 cr)

history.what: First plant at Aurangabad (Waluj); off-highway tyre production from 1995
history.impact: Built the niche: agricultural and industrial tyres, mostly for export replacement markets

history.what: Plants at Bhiwadi and Chopanki (Rajasthan); radial Agrimax (2004) and Earthmax (2008) ranges
history.impact: Capacity and the radial product range that took BKT into European farm replacement

history.what: Greenfield Bhuj complex (2015); carbon-black self-reliance (2020); replacement plant at Waluj (2021); Bhuj brownfield 50,000 MTPA (2022)
history.impact: Revenue +43% in FY22 on the post-Covid farm boom; Bhuj now the cost base, with captive carbon black and power

history.what: Margin squeeze: EBITDA margin (Screener basis) down to 18% from 24%

Advanced carbon materials (2024); PCR and CV radial capex announced (2025); US import duty on India raised to 50% from the second half of Q2FY26, BKT stopped shipping to the US (Q2FY26 call, Nov-2025); duty ~10% by May-2026 (Q4FY26 call); rupee weakness against forward hedges
history.impact: FY26 EPS -25% to Rs64.3: FX losses (Rs517 cr swing, standalone) and tariff-hit US volumes; volume +1% only

history.what: TBR launch (Feb-2026); Rs2,000 cr extra capex (total Rs6,800 cr to FY29); Deloitte proposed as joint auditor; record Q4 volume
history.impact: Debt rose to Rs4,111 cr (consolidated) by Mar-26; capex Rs2,984 cr in FY26

history.what: Record volume (93,770 MT); carbon black phase 2 (360,000 MTPA); on-highway go-live (TBR, 2-wheeler); new CFO
history.impact: Revenue +25% and PAT +57% (consolidated) on a weak, FX-hit base

guidance.said: No guidance given due to geopolitical uncertainty; expect growth
Ambition to take the US back to ~10% of volume in FY27 (just short of 10% in FY26), tariff now 10%
guidance.outcome: Q1 call: aim to restore US to 15-16% of revenue

guidance.said: Company-wide EBITDA margin to be sustained at 23-25% even as on-highway scales; near-term raw-material pressure
RM basket +4-5% in Q4FY26 and +7-8% more in Q1FY27; price hikes of 3-5% taken, ~2% more planned
guidance.outcome: Q1: ~5% hike; RM +5% more in Q2-Q3

guidance.said: FY27 capex Rs1,500-1,800 cr; Rs3,800 cr left of Rs6,800 cr to FY29; maintenance ~Rs200 cr extra
guidance.outcome: Raised in Jul: Rs2,500-3,000 cr for FY27

guidance.said: Rs23,000 cr revenue; growth 'closer to the second part' of the five years as capacities come on
RM +5% (≈3% of sales) partly offset by Q1 price hike: ~2pp margin impact in the coming quarter
Rs1,000 cr spent in Q1; Rs1,500-2,000 cr more in FY27; then 'descending'
